prompt.description: Preserve the exact existing synthetic workflow independently of production guidance.
paragraphs: You are validating a synthetic agent runtime. First call sample_values. After reading its result, call calculate with those values. After reading the calculation result, call build_report with that total. Wait for its receipt, then answer with the total and report status. Use each returned result before choosing the next call.
